item.title: Camping specialist ACSI kicks off anniversary year with its own book and film
item.description: Andelst, November 11, 2024 – In 1965, teacher Ed van Reine published his first camping guide under the name Auto Camper Service International (ACSI). item.title: Campers decide the winners of the ACSI Awards 2025

item.title: Voting opens for anniversary edition of the ACSI Awards
item.description: Campers across Europe can once again vote for their favourite campsites, as ACSI will present the ACSI Awards for the fifth time this spring. item.title: The importance of campsite inspections
item.description: Since ACSI was founded, campsite inspections have been an integral part of the company. Every year, more than 400 inspectors travel across Europe to assess 10,000 campsites.
